content: Letter 36 greets Khwāja Tāj al-Dīn Ḥasan ʿAṭṭār in eulogy of his spiritual stature, with a postscript greeting the disciples of his khanaqah and expressing longing to visit; MK takes him to be the son of ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn ʿAṭṭār (d. 802/1400), successor to Bahāʾ al-Dīn Naqshband ('presumably').
refers_to_primary: Munshaʾāt-i Turka, letter 36 (TMN/M f. 51b; TMN/MS p. 29)
